προσέφη: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg.
προσηύδα: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg.
προτὶ: πρός (epic προτί) — towards, to; prep. + acc.
πρόφρων: πρόφρων — willing, eager-minded, well-disposed; masc. nom. sg.
πρώτοισι: πρῶτος — first, foremost; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις): ’the foremost’
πρὶν: πρίν — before, sooner; adv./conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
πρὸς: πρός — towards, to; prep. + acc. · also + gen.: ’from, at the hands of’ (πρὸς Τρώων ’from the Trojans’) · also + gen. of witnesses: ’before, in the sight of’ (πρὸς θεῶν ’before the gods’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (πρὸς … ἔειπεν ’addressed’) · also adv., ’besides’ (πρὸς δ’ … ῥῆξε ’and besides … broke’) · also prep. + dat.: ’on, against’ (πρὸς χρυσῇ περόνῃ ’on a golden brooch’) · also + gen. of direction: ’toward, on the side of’ (πρὸς ἁλός ’toward the sea’)
πρῶτος: πρῶτος — first; masc. nom. sg., predicative: ’first (to do it)’
πτερόεντα: πτερόεις — winged (πτερόν ’feather, wing’); neut. acc. pl.: ’winged (words)’ · also masc. acc. sg., of an arrow: ’winged’
πτολέμοιο: πτόλεμος (πόλεμος) — war, battle; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic πολέμου)
πυκινὰς: πυκινός — thick, close-packed, dense; fem. acc. pl.
πόνου: πόνος — toil, labour, hardship; masc. gen. sg., after παύσαντο: ’from toil’ · also gen. sg. after λήγω: ’(never cease) from toil’
πότνια: πότνια — lady, mistress, revered; fem. nom. sg., title of a goddess or queen · also fem. voc. sg., in address: ’lady’

πᾶσι: πᾶς — all, every; masc./neut. dat. pl.
σάκος: σάκος — shield; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’the shield’ (σάκος … ἀνεδέξατο ’the shield received’)
σαρπηδών: Σαρπηδών — Sarpedon, a Lycian leader; masc. nom. sg.
στήθεσσι: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
σταθμοῖσιν: σταθμός — doorpost, door-jamb; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οῖς)
στενάχοντα: στενάχω — groan, moan; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’groaning’
στρατῷ: στρατός — army, host; masc. dat. sg.
στῆθος: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’breast’ (Ἥρῃ … στῆθος ’Hera’s breast’)
σφι: σφεῖς — they; epic encl. dat. pl. σφι: ’to/for them’ (= Attic αὐτοῖς)
σφιν: σφεῖς — they; epic encl. dat. pl./sg. pron.: ’to/for them’

τέρενα: τέρην, τέρεινα, τέρεν — tender, soft; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. pl. (same form)
τίς: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also indefinite τις after ὅς, written τίς: ’anyone, someone’ (ὅς τίς σφιν … ἡγήσαιτο ’anyone to lead them’) · also indefinite, written τίς: ’someone, one’ (ὡς δ’ ὅτε τίς τε δράκοντα ἰδών ’as when someone, seeing a snake’) · also indefinite τίς with a negative: ’no one’ (οὐ γάρ τίς … ἀνήρ ’for no man’) · also indefinite τις after μή, written τίς before the enclitic τοι: ’lest someone’ (μή τίς τοι … πήξῃ ’lest someone fix … in you’) · also indefinite τίς with a noun in a question after ἦ: ’some’ (ἦ τίς … θεός ’or some god’) · also indefinite τίς after μή, before the enclitic οἱ: ’lest anyone’ (μή τίς οἱ … κίοι ’lest anyone go off’)

τελαμώνιος: Τελαμώνιος — son of Telamon (patronymic adj.); masc. nom. sg.
τετάσθην: τείνω — stretch, stretch out; plpf. 3 dual mid./pass., unaugmented (= ἐτετάσθην): ’the two lay stretched out’
τεύχε: τεῦχος — armour, gear (pl. τεύχεα); neut. nom. pl., elided (τεύχε’ = τεύχεα) · also neut. acc. pl., elided: ’armour’ (τεύχε’ ἀπούρας ’having taken the armour’)
τεύχεα: τεῦχος — armor, gear; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted -εα (= Attic τεύχη)
τεὸν: τεός (epic possessive = σός) — your, yours; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with γέρας · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with μένος · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with φθόγγον: ’your’
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. nom./acc. sg. · in ὅ τι, ’whatever, why’ (= ὅτι) · also adverbial acc. with οὐ: ’at all’ (οὔ τι δυνήσεαι ’you will not at all be able’) · also adverbial acc. after εἰ: ’at all’ (εἴ ποτε δή τι … ὤνησας ’if ever you helped at all’) · also neut. acc. sg. with κακόν after μή: ’some’ (μή τι … ῥέξῃ κακὸν ’lest he do some evil’) · also adverbial acc. after μή: ’at all’ (μή τι διατρίβειν ’not to delay at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object of πάσχω after μή: ’any (harm)’ (μή τι πάθοι ’lest he suffer any harm’) · also adverbial acc. after αἴ κεν: ’somehow’ (αἴ κέν τι … γένηαι ’if somehow you become’) · also adverbial acc. after οὐδέ, with a partitive gen.: ’at all’ (οὐδέ τι τῶν μέμνηται ’nor does he remember any of it’) · also adverbial acc. after οὐδέ, with no partitive: ’at all’ (οὐδέ τι τίει ’does not honour at all’) · also neut. sg., agreeing with μῆχος after οὐδέ: ’any’ (οὐδέ τι μῆχος ’nor any means’) · also adverbial acc. after μήτε: ’at all’ (μήτέ τι νείκει ’nor find fault at all’) · also adverbial acc. with a comparative: ’somewhat’ (τι … ἄμεινον ’somewhat better’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with σπέος: ’a certain’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ὄφελος: ’some’ (ὄφελός τι ’some use’) · also adverbial acc. in a question after ἠέ: ’at all’ (ἠέ τι βέβληαι ’have you been hit at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object after εἰ: ’anything’ (εἴ τι … ῥέξει ’if … will do anything’)
τιν: τις, τι — someone, something; masc. acc. sg., elided (τιν’ = τινα) · also fem. acc. sg., agreeing with τιμήν: ’whatever’ (ἥν τιν’ ἔοικεν ’whatever is fitting’)

τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’ · also relative, masc. acc. pl.: ’whom’ · also masc. acc. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τοὺς ἄλλους ’the others’)
τοῖσι: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’to/among them’
τοῖόν: τοῖος — such, of such a kind; neut. acc. sg., with πῦρ (accent from the following enclitic)
τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. gen. sg., ’of him, him’ · also relative, ’whose’ · also with a noun, ’that’ (τοῦ βασιλῆος ’that king’) · also neut. gen. sg., ’of it’, after ἐκ: ’out of it’ (the chariot-board) · also neut. gen. sg. demonstrative, ’of this, that’, as the object of a verb taking the genitive (τοῦ δ’ ἐπιλήσονται ’but that they will forget’) · also neut. gen. sg. in ἐκ τοῦ, temporal: ’from that time’ · also masc. gen. sg., ’the other’, after πρό (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’) · also masc. gen. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’of it, its’ (τοῦ δέκα οἶμοι ’ten bands of it’)

τρῶας: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. acc. pl.
τυδεΐδης: Τυδεΐδης — son of Tydeus, i.e. Diomedes; masc. nom. sg. (patronymic)

τόσσόν: τόσσος — so much, so far; neut. acc. sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic τόσον), adverbial; correlative with ὅσον
τότ: τότε — then, at that time; adv., elided (τότ’ = τότε)
τώ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, they two’ (τώ γε) · also dual relative: ’the two who’ (τώ οἱ ἔσαν κήρυκε ’the two who were his heralds’) · also adverb (= Attic τῷ), ’therefore, so’ · also dual acc. relative: ’whom (the two)’ (τώ μοι … γείνατο ’whom … bore for me’) · also adverb (= Attic τῷ), in a consequence: ’in that case, then’ (τώ κε … ἀντήσειε ’then would he meet’)

τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg.: ’her’ · also relative, fem. acc. sg.: ’which’ (τὴν πρῶτον ἐπηπείλησ’ ’which he first threatened’) · also fem. acc. sg. with a noun, demonstrative: ’that’ (τὴν ὁδόν ’that journey’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’ · also masc. acc. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’it’ (τὸν δῶκε ’gave it’) · also masc. acc. sg., in the correlative τὸν μέν … τὸν δέ: ’the one … the other’
τῇ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; fem. dat. sg. · with an ordinal, ’on the (day)’: τῇ δεκάτῃ ’on the tenth’ · also adverbial, ’by that way, there’ · also fem. dat. sg. as relative adverb: ’by which way’ (τῇ … ἔμελλε διεξίμεναι ’by which he was about to go out’) · also fem. dat. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, my’ (τῇ ἐμῇ κλισίῃ ’my hut’) · also relative adverb: ’where’ (τῇ ῥα μάλιστα ’where especially’) · also fem. dat. sg. with the postpositive ὕπο: ’beneath it’ (τῇ ὕπο)
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these, of them, of which’ · also gen. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τῶν ἄλλων Τρώων ’the other Trojans’)
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc./neut. dat. sg., ’to him’ · also adverbial, ’therefore’ · also neut., ’on it’ (τῷ … ἐρεισάμενος ’leaning on it’) · also with a noun, ’that, the’ (ἤματι τῷ ’on that day’; τῷ δεκάτῳ ’in the tenth’) · also instrumental, ’with it’ (τῷ … τύψε ’struck with it’) · also relative, instrumental: ’with which’ · also causal/instrumental, ’by it’ (τῷ τείρετο ’was worn by it’) · also with ἅμα, of company: ’with him’ (τῷ … ἅμ’ ’along with him’) · also neut. dat. sg., ’in it’ (ἐν τῷ … κύκησε ’in it mixed’, of a cup)
υἷες: υἱός — son; masc. nom. pl., epic υἷες (= Attic υἱεῖς)
φάος: φάος — light (epic uncontracted = Attic φῶς); neut. nom./acc. sg.
φέρον: φέρω — carry, bear; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔφερον): ’were carrying’
φίλον: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. voc. sg., agreeing with τέκος: ’dear (child)’
φίλος: φίλος — dear, beloved; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’dear (to him)’ · also attributive, ’dear’ (φίλος υἱός ’dear son’) · also masc. voc. sg., in address: ’dear (Menelaus)’
φαίδιμος: φαίδιμος — shining, glorious, illustrious; masc. nom. sg., epithet of Hector · also epithet of Ajax (φαίδιμος Αἴας) · also epithet of Glaucus (φαίδιμος υἱός ’glorious son’)
φημὶ: φημί — say, assert, declare; pres. 1 sg.
φιλότητι: φιλότης — friendship, love, affection; also sexual love; fem. dat. sg.: ἐν φιλότητι ’in love’
φωνὴ: φωνή — voice, sound; fem. nom. sg.
φωτὶ: φώς — man, mortal; masc. dat. sg., after ἐοικώς: ’(like) a man’ · also masc. dat. sg., with μάχεσθαι: ’a man’ (ἀμείνονι φωτὶ μάχεσθαι ’to fight a better man’) · also masc. dat. sg., indirect object of κέλευε: ’to each man’ (φωτὶ ἑκάστῳ)
χέρεια: χερείων (χέρης) — worse, inferior; comparative of κακός; masc. acc. sg., epic χέρεια (= χερείονα, Attic χείρονα) · also neut. nom./acc. pl.
χαλεπαίνων: χαλεπαίνω — be harsh, be angry, rage; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’in anger’
χαλεπὸς: χαλεπός — hard, harsh, grievous; masc. nom. sg.
χαλκὸν: χαλκός — bronze; masc. acc. sg.: ’the bronze’ (i.e. armour) · also the bronze weapon, the spear-point: ’the bronze’ (χαλκὸν ἀνασχέσθαι ’to withstand the bronze’)
χαμαὶ: χαμαί — on the ground, to the ground; adv.
χειρὸς: χείρ — hand; fem. gen. sg.; χειρὸς ἑλόντε ’taking by the hand’ (gen. of the part seized) · also fem. gen. sg. of separation, with ἀπό in tmesis: ’from the hand’ (ἀπ’ … χειρὸς ὀμόργνυ) · also fem. gen. sg. of separation, with ἐκ in tmesis: ’out of the hand’ (ἐκ … χειρὸς σπάσσατο ’wrenched out of the hand’) · also fem. gen. sg. of separation after ἀπό: ’from the hand’ (ἐμῆς ἀπὸ χειρὸς ’from my hand’) · also fem. gen. sg. after διά: ’through the hand’ (διὰ χειρός)
χερμαδίῳ: χερμάδιον — hand-sized stone, rock used as a missile; neut. dat. sg., of means: ’with a stone’
χερσίν: χείρ — hand; fem. dat. pl., ν-movable (cf. epic χερσί)
χθονὸς: χθών — earth, ground; fem. gen. sg.: κατὰ χθονὸς ’down upon the ground’
χθὼν: χθών — earth, ground; fem. nom. sg.
χροῒ: χρώς — skin, flesh, the body’s surface; dat. sg. χροΐ
χρυσείην: χρύσειος — golden, of gold; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with κυνέην
χρόα: χρώς — skin, flesh, complexion; masc. acc. sg. χρόα
χρύσεον: χρύσεος — golden; neut. acc. sg., uncontracted (= Attic χρυσοῦν), agreeing with δέπας · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with θρόνον: ’golden (throne)’
χώσατο: χώομαι — be angry, be enraged; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐχώσατο): ’was enraged’
ἀγήνωρ: ἀγήνωρ — lordly, manly, proud; adj. (2-termination), masc./fem. nom. sg. · also the proper name Ἀγήνωρ — Agenor, a Trojan leader; masc. nom. sg.
ἀγαμέμνων: Ἀγαμέμνων — Agamemnon, king of Mycenae, leader of the Achaeans at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
ἀγγελίην: ἀγγελίη — message, news; fem. acc. sg.
ἀγκὰς: ἀγκάς — in the arms, in an embrace; adv.
ἀγχοῦ: ἀγχοῦ — near, close by; adv. (by-form of ἄγχι)
ἀείρας: ἀείρω — lift, raise (Attic αἴρω); aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having lifted’
ἀθρήσειε: ἀθρέω — gaze, look closely; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a past general clause after ὅτε: ’whenever he looked’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg., in a purpose clause after ἵνα μή in past sequence: ’might see’

ἀλαλητῷ: ἀλαλητός — war-cry, shout; masc. dat. sg., of manner: ’with a shout’
ἀλεγεινῇ: ἀλεγεινός — painful, grievous; fem. dat. sg., with ἀγγελίῃ
ἀλεείνων: ἀλεείνω — shun, avoid; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’avoiding’
ἀλλ: ἀλλά (elided ἀλλ’) — but; well then · also ’except’: ’but only’ (ἀλλ’ οἶοι ’except us two’)
ἀλλήλοισιν: ἀλλήλων — one another; reciprocal pron., masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις): ’to one another’
ἀμυνέμεν: ἀμύνω — ward off, defend; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἀμύνειν)
ἀμυνέμεναι: ἀμύνω — ward off, defend; pres. inf. act., epic -έμεναι (= Attic ἀμύνειν)

ἀμύμων: ἀμύμων — blameless, excellent (an old epithet whose exact force is uncertain); masc./fem. nom. sg.
ἀνθρώπων: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; masc. gen. pl.

ἀπαμειβόμενος: ἀπαμείβομαι — answer, reply; pres. part. nom. sg. masc.
ἀπιόντα: ἄπειμι (εἶμι) — go away; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.

ἀρήγων: ἀρήγω — help, aid (+ dat.); pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’helping’
ἀρήϊα: ἀρήϊος — of Ares, warlike; neut. acc. pl., epic ἀρήϊα, agreeing with τεύχεα · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with ἔντεα: ’warlike (gear)’
ἀργείοισιν: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
ἀργείων: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἀργεῖοι: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’Argives!’
ἀρχὸς: ἀρχός — leader, chief; masc. nom. sg.
ἀσπίδι: ἀσπίς — shield; fem. dat. sg., of means: ’by his shield’ · also fem. dat. sg. after ὑπό: ’under the shield’ (ὑπ’ ἀσπίδι)
ἀστεροπῇ: ἀστεροπή — lightning, flash (Attic ἀστραπή); fem. dat. sg., after ἐναλίγκιος
ἀτρέμας: ἀτρέμας — without moving, calmly, quietly; adv.
ἀτρεΐδης: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus (patronymic); masc. nom. sg.
ἀφάμαρτε: ἀφαμαρτάνω — miss; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἀφήμαρτε): ’missed’
ἀχαιῶν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἀχιλλεὺς: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles, son of Peleus; masc. nom. sg.
ἀϋσάντων: ἀΰω — shout, cry out; aor. part. masc. gen. pl.: ’shouting’
ἂν: ἀνά — up, aboard; prep./preverb, with apocope ἂν before δ’; in tmesis (ἂν … βήσομεν ’put aboard’) · also modal particle ἄν (= κεν) written ἂν: with the opt., potential: ’would’; with the subj. after εὖτ’: ’whenever’ · also with ὡς + subj.: ’in the way that’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I may say’) · also modal particle with the subj. after ὅτ’: ’whenever’ (ὅτ’ ἂν … γένωνται ’whenever they come to be’) · also modal particle with a fut. or short-vowel subj.: ’could’ (οὐκ ἂν … μυθήσομαι ’I could not tell’) · also εἴ περ ἂν + opt., ’even if … should’ · also εἴ περ ἂν + subj., ’even if … ever’ (εἴ περ ἂν αὐτὸν σεύωνται ’even if they set upon him’) · also εἰ … ἂν + subj., ’if ever, should’ (εἰ δ’ ἂν … ἐθέλωσιν ’but if they should be unwilling’) · also with an indic. past tense, contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἂν … ἦεν ’would have been’) · also modal particle ἄν with the subj. after ὄφρα: ’until, while’ (ὄφρ’ ἂν … βείω ’until I go’) · also modal particle ἄν after ἐπεί + subj.: ’once’ (ἐπεὶ ἂν … ἐπίσπῃς ’once you have met’) · also modal particle with the subj. in a general relative clause: ’whomever’ (ὃν … ἂν … νοήσω ’whomever I notice’) · also modal particle ἄν with an infinitive in reported speech, keeping the ’would’ of the direct words: ’he said he would’ (ἂν … ἔφη παραμυθήσασθαι) · also ἂν = ἀνά before ν, prep. + acc.: ’up through’ (ἂν νέκυας ’up through the corpses’)
ἄγεθ: ἄγω — lead, bring; imper. 2 pl., elided (ἄγεθ’ = ἄγετε), as an interjection: ’come now!’
ἄκοιτιν: ἄκοιτις — wife, bedfellow; fem. acc. sg.
ἄκρῳ: ἄκρος — topmost, at the tip; masc./neut. dat. sg. (ἐπ’ ἄκρῳ ’at the tip’)
ἄλλοι: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’(you) other (gods)’ (Ζεῦ ἄλλοι τε θεοί)
ἄντυγος: ἄντυξ — rim, rail of a chariot; fem. gen. sg., with ἐκ: ’from the rail’
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, short form ἄρ (elided ἄρ’ before a vowel)
ἄρά: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, accented ἄρά before an enclitic
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, then, as it turned out; inferential particle
ἄρηται: ἄρνυμαι — win, gain; aor. subj. 3 sg. mid., in a purpose clause after ἵνα: ’she may win’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg. mid., after μή, of fear: ’lest he take (upon himself)’
ἄρισται: ἀγαθός — good; superlative ἄριστος ’best’; fem. nom. pl. ἄρισται, predicate (of mares): ’best, foremost’
ἄριστοι: ἄριστος — best; superl. of ἀγαθός, masc. nom. pl.
ἄστυ: ἄστυ — town, city; neut. acc. sg.
ἅπαντα: ἅπας — all, the whole of; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with μιν: ’the whole of it’ · also neut. acc. pl., agreeing with a noun: ’all (the sorrows)’
ἐγγὺς: ἐγγύς — near, close by; adv. · also prep. + gen.: ’near’
ἐγὼν: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg., form used before a vowel
ἐδυνήσατο: δύναμαι — be able, can; aor. 3 sg. (deponent), sigmatic ἐδυνήσατο (Attic ἐδυνήθη): ’was able’
ἐθέλεις: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing, intend; pres. 2 sg.
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐκέλευσεν: κελεύω — command, order, bid; aor. 3 sg.: ’ordered’
ἐλπόμενοι: ἔλπομαι — hope, expect; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl., + inf.: ’hoping’
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐννοσιγαίῳ: ἐννοσίγαιος — earth-shaker, epithet of Poseidon; masc. dat. sg., epic (cf. ἐνοσίχθων)
ἐνοσίχθων: ἐνοσίχθων — earth-shaker, epithet of Poseidon (from ἔνοσις ’shaking’ + χθών ’earth’); masc. nom. sg.
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’) · also in ἐξ αὖτις, adverbial: ’again, once more’
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, at; + dat./acc./gen. · also + acc., ’to, towards’ (βῆ δ’ ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδην ’went to the son of Atreus’) · also + dat., ’to’ (πέμψαι ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδῃ ’to send to’) · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπ’ … θήσειν ’to lay upon’) · also + acc. of time, ’until, at’ (ἐπ’ ἠέλιον δῦναι ’until the sun sets’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ἐπ’ ἀλλήλοισιν ἰόντες ’coming against one another’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐπ’ ὠκεανοῖο ῥοάων ’toward the streams of Oceanus’) · also adv., ’next, after them’ (τοῖσι δ’ ἐπ’ Ἰδομενεύς ’and after them Idomeneus’) · also + dat. of place, ’close by, hard by’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ τάφρον ὄρυξαν ’dug a ditch close by it’) · also + dat. of time, ’within, in’ (ἐπ’ ἤματι ’in a single day’) · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (left) side’ (ἐπ’ ἀριστερόφιν ’on the left’) · also + gen., ’on’ (ἐπ’ εὐνάων ’on anchor-stones’)
ἐπεί: ἐπεί — after, since, when; conj. · with κε + subj.: ’whenever, once’
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’) · also adv., ’besides, in addition’ (ἐπὶ δὲ … ὅρκον ὀμοῦμαι ’besides, I shall swear an oath’) · also adv., ’on it, upon it’ (ἐπὶ … ζυγὸν ἦεν ’there was a yoke upon it’) · also + dat. of time: ’for, during’ (ἐπὶ νυκτί ’for the night’) · also + dat., ’over, for’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσι ’over possessions’) · also + gen., ’for’ (ἐπὶ δώρων ’for the gifts’; force uncertain) · also + dat. of place: ’at’ (ἐπὶ τάφρῳ ’at the ditch’) · also ἐπὶ ἶσα, adverbial: ’equally, evenly’ · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (right) side’ (ἐπὶ δεξιόφιν ’on the right’)
ἐρέων: ἐρέω (= ἐρωτάω) — ask, inquire after; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐρωτῶν), + acc. of the thing: ’asking after’ · also ἐρέω (fut. of εἶπον) — say, tell; fut. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐρῶν), of purpose: ’to tell’ (ἔπος ἐρέων ’to tell a word’)
ἐρύεσθαι: ἐρύομαι — rescue, protect, draw to safety; pres. inf. mid.: ’to rescue’
ἐσθλὰ: ἐσθλός — good, noble, staunch; neut. acc. pl.: ’good things, good deeds’
ἐσθλὸς: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; masc. nom. sg.: ’good’
ἐτώσιον: ἐτώσιος — vain, fruitless; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’in vain’
ἐχάζετο: χάζομαι — draw back, give way, retire; impf. 3 sg. mid.
ἐών: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic ἐών (= Attic ὤν): ’being’
ἑάφθη: ἅπτω — fasten, attach; aor. pass. 3 sg., epic ἑάφθη (= Attic ἥφθη; formation not certain), with ἐπί in tmesis: ’was laid upon’
ἑλόντες: αἱρέω — take, capture; aor. part. act., masc. nom. pl.: ’having taken’
ἑτάρων: ἑταῖρος (epic ἕταρος) — companion, comrade; masc. gen. pl.
ἑτέρωθεν: ἑτέρωθεν — from the other side; adv. with suffix -θεν
ἑταῖροι: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. nom. pl.
ἓν: εἷς, μία, ἕν — one; neut. nom./acc. sg., in the compound number: ’twenty-one’ (καὶ ἓν καὶ εἴκοσι)
ἔγχε: ἔγχος — spear; neut. acc. pl., elided uncontracted (ἔγχε’ = ἔγχεα; Attic ἔγχη)
ἔγωγε: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg. with the strengthening particle -γε: ’I for my part’
ἔδυνε: δύνω (by-form of δύω) — put on, enter; impf. 3 sg. act., transitive: ’put on’
ἔειπες: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 2 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept (ἔειπες = εἶπες)
ἔεργε: εἴργω (ἔργω) — shut in, enclose; impf. 3 sg., epic ἔεργε (= Attic εἶργε): ’enclosed’
ἔθνος: ἔθνος — company, band, throng; neut. acc. sg.
ἔκφυγε: ἐκφεύγω — flee out, escape; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐξέφυγε)
ἔνθ: ἔνθα (elided ἔνθ’) — there, then; adverb of place or time
ἔνι: ἐν — in; prep. + dat., postpositive with accent thrown back after its noun (νέεσσ’ ἔνι = Attic ἐν ναυσί) · also ἔνι = ἔνεστι, ἔνεισι, accented on the first syllable: ’is in, are in’ (οὔ οἱ ἔνι φρένες ’there are no wits in him’)
ἔοι: εἰμί — be; pres. opt. 3 sg., epic (= Attic εἴη)
ἔπεα: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)
ἔπειτ: ἔπειτα (elided ἔπειτ’) — then, next, after that
ἔπεσ: πίπτω — fall; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἔπεσ’ = ἔπεσε), in tmesis with ἐν: ’fell into’
ἔπι: ἐπί — on, upon, over; prep. + dat., placed after its relative with anastrophe (ᾧ ἔπι = ἐφ’ ᾧ ’for which’) · also ἔπι = ἔπεστι, ’is there’, verb with anastrophe (οὐ … ἔπι δέος ’there is no fear’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί placed after its noun, with anastrophe: ’at’ (πηγῇς ἔπι ’at the springs’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + acc. placed after its noun, ’to’ (νῆας ἔπι γλαφυράς ’to the hollow ships’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun: ’to’ (νηυσὶν ἔπι γλαφυρῇσιν ’to the hollow ships’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + acc. placed after its noun, ’over’ (πόντον ἔπι ’over the sea’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί as a preverb in tmesis (ὦρσεν ἔπι = ἐπῶρσεν ’roused against’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun, ’for’ (δώρῳ ἔπι μεγάλῳ ’for a great gift’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun: ’at, against’ (Τυδεΐδῃ ἔπι … τόξα τιταίνετο ’drew his bow at Tydeides’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun, of place: ’by, along’ (ὁδῷ ἔπι ’by the road’)
ἔπλετο: πέλομαι — be, become; aor. 3 sg. mid., no augment, with pres. force or gnomic in a simile: ’comes to be, is’ · also ordinary past: ’came to be’
ἔριδα: ἔρις — strife, rivalry, contest; fem. acc. sg. · also Ἔρις — Strife, the goddess; fem. acc. sg.
ἔσσεται: εἰμί — be; fut. 3 sg., epic doubled σ (= Attic ἔσται)
ἔσσευε: σεύω — drive, set rushing; aor. 3 sg. act., epic augmented form with doubled σ (ἔσσευε for ἔσευε): ’sent rushing’
ἔστιν: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., with movable ν: ’is’ · also with an infinitive, ’it is possible to’ (ἔστιν ἐρίζειν ’it is possible to rival’)
ἔτευξεν: τεύχω — make, fashion; aor. 3 sg., augmented
ἔφαθ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid. (ἔφατο, elided ἔφαθ’, τ>θ before rough breathing)
ἔχε: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἶχε) · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’hold, keep’
ἔχει: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. 3 sg. · also intransitive with an adverb, ’be in a state’: εὖ … κομιδὴ ἔχει ’the tending is in good order’
ἔχματα: ἔχμα — support, prop, foundation (ἔχω ’hold’); neut. acc. pl.
ἔχοντες: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
ἔχων: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’holding’
ἕκτορα: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. acc. sg.
ἕκτορι: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. dat. sg.: ’for Hector’
ἕκτορος: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam, chief Trojan hero; masc. gen. sg.
ἕκτωρ: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. nom. sg.
ἕλῃ: αἱρέω — take, seize; in battle, kill; aor. subj. 3 sg., after εἰ κεν: ’takes, kills’
ἕστασαν: ἵστημι — stand; plpf. 3 pl., intransitive (= Attic εἱστήκεσαν): ’stood, were standing’ (reduplicated ἑ-στα-σαν)
ἠέλιός: Ἠέλιος — the Sun; masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic Ἥλιος), accented before the enclitic τε
ἠδὲ: ἠδέ — and; epic conj. (τε … ἠδέ ’both … and’)
ἡμεῖς: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; nom. pl.: ’we’
ἡνίοχόν: ἡνίοχος — charioteer; masc. acc. sg. (accent from the enclitic τε)
ἣν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (fem. acc. sg.)
ἤτοι: ἤτοι (also printed ἦ τοι) — truly, surely; affirming particle, often barely translatable at the head of a formula
ἥρη: Ἥρη (Ionic/epic by-form of Ἥρα) — Hera, wife of Zeus; fem. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form) in address: ’Hera!’
ἥφαιστος: Ἥφαιστος — Hephaestus, god of the forge; nom. sg.
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’) · also ἦ … ἦ ’either … or’
ἦρχε: ἄρχω — begin, rule, lead; impf. 3 sg., absolute: ’led the way’ · also + gen. of the people or ships led: ’was leading’ (τῶν ἦρχε … νεῶν) · also + gen. of what is begun: ’began, led off’ (μύθων ἦρχε ’led off the talk’) · also + dat. of the troops led: ’led’ (ἦρχε … σφιν ’led them’)
ἰδὲ: ἰδέ — and; epic conj. (= Attic καί)
ἱστάμενος: ἵστημι — set, stand; pres. mid. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’standing’
ἴδης: Ἴδη — Mount Ida; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic Ἴδης)
ἴδηται: εἶδον (aor. of ὁράω) — see; aor. subj. mid. 3 sg., purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’that he may see’
ἴμεν: εἶμι — go; pres. inf., epic (= Attic ἰέναι)
ἴομεν: εἶμι — go; pres. subj. 1 pl., hortatory: ’let us go’
ἵκεθ: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive; aor. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἵκεθ’ = ἵκετο, θ for τ before a rough breathing): ’came to’
ἵνα: ἵνα — so that, in order that; conj. + subj. · also relative adv., ’where’ (ἵνα τ’ ἄνδρες … τελέθουσι ’where men become’)
ὀδυσεύς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. nom. sg., single-σ metrical variant
ὀλίγον: ὀλίγος — small, little, slight; neut. acc. sg.: ’a small (prize)’ · also neut. acc. sg. adverbially: ’little’ (ὀλίγον … ἐοικότα ’little like’)
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’) · also masc. nom. sg., ’the one’ set against a genitive ’the other’ (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’)
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄπαζε: ὀπάζω — grant, bestow, give as a companion; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐπόπαζε): ’kept granting’
ὄπισθε: ὄπισθε(ν) — behind, at the back; adv.
ὄρουσαν: ὀρούω — rush, leap, spring up; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ὤρουσαν): ’they rushed, leapt’
ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic; + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indic. (ὄφρ’ Ἀχιλεὺς μήνιεν ’while Achilles was angry’) · also temporal, ’until’ + indic. (ὄφρ’ ἵππω πλήξαντε … βάλον ’until the two horses struck … and threw’) · also temporal, ’while’ + subj. in a general clause (ὄφρ’ εὕδῃσι ’while … sleeps’) · also temporal ’until, while’ + ἄν + subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν … βείω ’until I go’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ ἀπόλοιτο ’so that he might perish’) · also temporal, ’while’ with ἄν + subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν ἐγὼ … δύω ’while I put on’)
ὄψεσθαι: ὁράω — see; fut. inf. mid. (ὄψομαι), in indirect speech after φησί: ’that he will see’
ὅθ: ὅθι (elided ὅθ’) — where; relative adv. of place · also ὅτε (elided and aspirated ὅθ’) — when; temporal conj.
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’)
ὅσσαι: ὅσος — as much as, as many as; fem. nom. pl., epic ὅσσαι (= ὅσαι), agreeing with ἐσχάραι: ’as many as’
ὅτε: ὅτε — when, whenever; temporal conj. · also ὅτε μή + opt., ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ … ἐμβάλοι ’unless … should throw’)
ὅττί: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; neut. acc. sg. ὅττι (doubled τ), accented before the enclitic κεν · also ὅττι = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οὐδέ τι ᾔδη ὅττι … ’nor did he know that …’)
ὑπὲρ: ὑπέρ — over, beyond; + gen.: ’on behalf of’ (ὑπὲρ Δαναῶν) · also + acc., ’beyond’ (ὑπὲρ αἶσαν ’beyond due measure’) · also + gen. of place, ’above’ (στέρνον ὑπὲρ μαζοῖο ’the breast above the nipple’) · also + acc. of motion, ’over’ (ὑπὲρ ὦμον ’over the shoulder’) · also + gen., ’about, concerning’ (ὑπὲρ σέθεν αἴσχε’ ἀκούω ’I hear shameful things about you’)
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’under (the blast of)’ (ὑπὸ Ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς) · also prep. + dat. of cause, placed after its noun: ’under the weight of’ (καμάτῳ … ὑπό ’from toil’) · also prep. + acc. after ἀλύξας, of escape: ’from under’ (ὑπὸ κῆρας ἀλύξας ’escaping the death-fates’) · also prep. + dat. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Τρώεσσι δαμῆναι ’to be overcome by the Trojans’)
ὑψόσ: ὑψόσε — up on high, aloft; adv., elided ὑψόσ’
ὕλην: ὕλη — wood, timber, brushwood; fem. acc. sg. · also Ὕλη — Hyle, a Boeotian town; fem. acc. sg.
ὠκέας: ὠκύς — swift; masc. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὠκεῖς)
ὠκὺ: ὠκύς — swift, quick; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’) · also correlative with ὣς: ’as surely as’ (ὣς … ὡς, in a wish like an oath) · also adverb, demonstrative: ’so, in that way’ (ὡς ἂν … οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι ’so I would not wish’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὤρετο: ὄρνυμι — rouse; mid. rise, bestir oneself; aor. 3 sg. mid., augmented, + inf.: ’bestirred himself, set himself (to)’
ὦκα: ὦκα — quickly, swiftly; adv., from ὠκύς
ᾤχετ: οἴχομαι — go, be gone; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (ᾤχετ’ = ᾤχετο): ’went’
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
ῥά: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, weak enclitic form ῥα, accented ῥά
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
